mentions.name: Jupjup
mentions.description: Chrome and Firefox extension for language learning that lets you save words and phrases from websites you visit, including Netflix and YouTube, and then review them with spaced repetition flashcards.
mentions.problem: Wanted a better way to make flash cards and learn from sites visited, Netflix, and YouTube while learning Korean.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made Jupjup (https://getjupjup.com) as a chrome and Firefox extension that lets you save words and phrases from all over and then do spaced repetition to remember them.
mentions.author: Ilasky
